svg.title: Evidence-backed agent lifecycle state machine
svg.desc: A deployed capability begins with a versioned charter, enters an observation window, and receives a mandate-specific evidence envelope. Missing evidence returns it to observation. Suspected low value enters a safety-checked pause and feed probe that records exclusions, supports emergency abort, restores the capability, and verifies restoration before feeding defined work. Sufficient evidence reaches a human-signed immutable decision to invest, specialize, merge or subsume, repurpose, pause, or retire. The selected decision type remains attached to its implementation. Retirement alone enters a cleanup contract that verifies consumer and work migration, queue disposition, credential revocation, data and memory handling, ownership transfer, and the applicable restore window before termination. Other verified outcomes return to scheduled or event-triggered reassessment.
